lane: H1 lidar scarp-dipole polarity + segment coherence, piedmont-gated, frontier-hybrid emission
hypothesis: Young normal-fault scarps missing from the Quaternary catalogue are signed lidar dipoles (crest convexity lapneg + base concavity lappos + dominant face polarity) that are strike-coherent over >500 m in low-relief piedmont settings; emitting them as 2.83 px-spaced dots half inside the corroborated H19-5 corridor and half on novel off-network strands recovers faults the catalogue and the champion family missed.
mechanism: Dequantised USGS-3DEP 2 m lidar aggregate channels -> percentile-rank geomean dipole (lapneg, lappos, max(upface,downface), step) x coh100 x (1-0.5 cross-dominance) -> segment coherence (max directional mean, 4 orientations, +-4 px) -> piedmont setting factor (relief/slope rank penalty) x TIGER road-distance factor x contour factor -> greedy dotted placement (2.83 px inhibition), d_cat>=sqrt(5) px B2 trim, 40,000 dots (pool A d_H19-5<=2 px; pool B off-network and >3 px from champion+skarpline); uniqueness repair vs full registry; binary 1.0 emission, zeros outside footprint.
named_non_fault_mimic: Lahontan shoreline/terrace risers and road cut-and-fill benches (mitigated, not eliminated, by cross-dominance, road-distance and along-strike elevation-change factors).

submission_note: WBG3 dipole-hybrid: lidar scarp-dipole x segment coherence, piedmont-gated; 40% corridor + 60% novel; d2.83 dotted, B2 trim
verdict_reason: The file is unique, format-valid and geology-driven, and sits inside the archive's >=0.219 analog frontier (median analog 0.23), but no available instrument demonstrates beating the champion's owner-reported 0.2778: ledger lambda is unidentified off-network, the SGMC density-matched proxy ranks it below the champion, and hide-and-recover is an anti-proxy for off-catalogue placement. Beat-0.2778 hypothesis: NOT supported. Slot selection is a separate selector step; if a slot is spent on a unique entry, this is the lane's candidate, with final-round expert-review discovery value as the upside.
